title: SSE endpoints bypass ownership checks
description: handleSSEJob (/api/jobs/{jobID}/events) and handleSSEGlobal (/api/events) have no ownership checks. Any authenticated user can subscribe to real-time events for any job. handleSSEJob needs auth.CanAccessJob check before subscribing. handleSSEGlobal should be restricted to admin-only. Discovered during code review of dashboard ownership filtering (readiness gap 9).

title: Add API authentication for Anthropic backend
description: The API server has no authentication. With the Anthropic backend, unauthenticated access allows submitting jobs that burn real API credits and execute code via a frontier model. Options: API key auth, localhost-only binding, or a config guard requiring explicit opt-in. This was identified in PR #20 security review as MEDIUM priority.
